review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: Senior Solutions Engineer – Infrastructure & Azure Location: Central London Working pattern: Hybrid (3 days per week in office) If you’re the engineer everyone turns to when the straightforward fixes have run out—and you’re ready for more ownership than simply handling the hardest tickets—this opportunity should be worth a look. We’re working with a fast-growing London-based Managed Services Provider that has built its success around two things: delivering exceptionally high standards for its customers and creating an environment where talented people can do their best work. The culture is ambitious, collaborative and refreshingly human. Good ideas are listened to, people are trusted to make an impact, and technical development is actively supported rather than simply promised during the interview process. This is a business that works hard, celebrates success and invests in its people through structured development, funded learning and genuine opportunities to progress. The Opportunity As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you’ll become a technical escalation point within the engineering team while taking ownership of complex infrastructure and cloud projects from initial discovery through to successful delivery. You’ll work directly with customers, lead technical implementations, improve engineering standards and mentor less-experienced colleagues. The environment is varied and technically broad. One day you could be troubleshooting a complex virtualised server environment; the next, leading an Azure deployment, network upgrade or disaster recovery project. What You’ll Be Doing Acting as a senior technical escalation point for complex infrastructure, cloud, networking and security issues. Leading infrastructure projects from planning and design through to implementation, documentation and handover. Delivering server migrations, virtualisation deployments, Azure solutions and network upgrades. Working directly with customers to understand their requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions. Managing expectations and communicating clearly throughout complex implementations. Designing and implementing security solutions across firewalls, endpoints and cloud environments. Supporting disaster recovery planning and the implementation of resilient backup solutions. Mentoring junior engineers and helping them develop their technical and troubleshooting capabilities. Improving engineering standards, processes and technical documentation. Producing clear system documentation, performance reports and recommendations for customers. The Technical Background You’ll need strong hands-on experience across the following: Windows Server administration, configuration and advanced troubleshooting. Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy and WDS. Server virtualisation using Hyper-V and/or VMware. Microsoft Azure, including Azure AD/Entra ID, Virtual Machines and Storage. Backup and disaster recovery technologies such as Veeam, Cove or Acronis. Networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLANs, subnetting, VPNs and LAGs. Configuring and managing enterprise firewalls such as Fortinet, Juniper, WatchGuard or Palo Alto. Storage platforms such as Dell PowerVault or Synology, including LUNs, RAID and storage pools. Endpoint security technologies, ideally Microsoft Defender and/or Sophos. Delivering complex server, cloud and network infrastructure projects. You don’t need to have worked with every product listed above. What matters is that you have strong infrastructure fundamentals, broad technical experience and the ability to take ownership when an issue or project becomes complex. Who This Will Suit You may currently be working as a: Senior Infrastructure Engineer Senior Third-Line Engineer Senior Systems Engineer Lead Infrastructure Engineer Senior Technical Engineer Senior Systems Administrator Infrastructure Consultant You MUST have experience working within an MSP or another fast-paced, customer-facing technology environment. Just as importantly, you’ll be someone who communicates well, remains calm under pressure and takes pride in delivering work properly. You should be comfortable speaking directly with customers, mentoring other engineers and taking accountability for technical outcomes. If you’re looking for a senior infrastructure role where you can remain hands-on, own meaningful projects and become a trusted technical leader, we’d be interested in speaking with you. Apply now or contact Cloud Decisions for a confidential conversation.

Essential Responsibilities: The Senior Infrastructure Engineer serves as the technical lead for the organization's enterprise infrastructure, responsible for the architecture, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of compute, storage, network, virtualization, and identity management platforms. This position provides strategic and operational leadership for critical infrastructure services across a variety of classified networks, establishes engineering standards, drives modernization initiatives, and ensures the reliability, security, and scalability of systems supporting customer operations. The role requires extensive hands-on technical expertise, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to lead complex projects and maintenance activities in a secure enterprise environment. Develop and maintain infrastructure standards, engineering best practices, system baselines, and technical roadmaps. Lead infrastructure modernization efforts, technology refresh projects, migrations, and lifecycle management activities. Manage enterprise storage solutions, data protection strategies, backups, disaster recovery capabilities, and capacity planning initiatives. Evaluate emerging technologies and provide technical recommendations for infrastructure improvements and future-state architectures. Develop and maintain technical documentation including architectures, diagrams, procedures, standards, and operational runbooks. Demonstrated ability to architect and establish enterprise infrastructure standards, develop technical roadmaps, evaluate emerging technologies, and lead infrastructure modernization initiatives aligned with business objectives. Extensive hands-on experience administering Microsoft Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file services, authentication systems, and enterprise identity management solutions. Strong experience managing enterprise storage platforms, including SAN, NAS, backup, disaster recovery, replication, capacity planning, and data protection strategies. Advanced understanding of Windows server operating systems, including system hardening, patch management, performance tuning, automation, and lifecycle management. Experience leading infrastructure maintenance and operational activities within production environments, including change management, patching, upgrades, disaster recovery testing, and after-hours maintenance windows. Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical projects from design through implementation, collaborating across technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure successful delivery and operational readiness. Expert troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform root cause analysis, resolve critical infrastructure issues, and develop long-term corrective actions for enterprise systems. Strong knowledge of cybersecurity principles and infrastructure security practices, including vulnerability remediation, system hardening, access controls, compliance requirements, and secure infrastructure design. Experience developing technical documentation, operational procedures, infrastructure standards, and architectural diagrams to support enterprise governance and knowledge management. Proven ability to serve as a senior technical leader and mentor, providing guidance to engineers, establishing best practices, and driving continuous improvement across infrastructure operations. review_candidates.title: Linux Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: Linux Systems Administrator LegalSight is a creative and innovative company that develops software for a broad range of legal and business functions. Our team includes veterans of the legal services industry, technology experts, and business operations professionals. We leverage our expertise to maximize opportunities for improved workflows and processes. We bring together our talent and technology to help clients achieve greater operational efficiency, reduce risks, and take advantage of innovative software solutions. We're looking for a hands-on Linux Systems Administrator who likes getting into the guts of a system and making it perform optimally. The candidate must take ownership of the infrastructure and keep it healthy and secure.You'll manage our Linux servers, virtualization, cloud footprint, and network edge, and you'll have plenty of latitude to shape how it all fits together. We expect strong Linux fundamentals, a genuine curiosity about how systems work, and the drive to grow into the unfamiliar parts. We need someone who is comfortable reading logs, scripting fixes, and documenting their work. In your first few months you'll take ownership of the Linux and virtualization environment, help move us off SonicWall onto OPNsense cleanly, and put automation and monitoring in place so the infrastructure runs quietly and predictably. Over time you'll grow into the broader systems role we need, steadily making the environment more secure and more automated. **Candidates must live within commutable distance to our office in Ocean City, NJ and must be able to work in-office two (2) days per week. Responsibilities: Administer and maintain Linux servers (Ubuntu): provisioning, patching, hardening, storage, users/permissions, and day-to-day troubleshooting. Manage our Proxmox virtualization environment: VMs and containers, resource allocation, snapshots, backups, and keeping the cluster healthy. Own the network edge and firewall: we currently run SonicWall and are transitioning to OPNsense, so you'll help drive that migration and then run it (firewall rules, VPN, DNS, and routing). Automate the repetitive stuff: write Bash/Python scripts so routine admin work, provisioning, and monitoring run themselves instead of consuming your day. We leverage AI tooling (including Claude) day-to-day, and you're welcome to use it here too. Set up and maintain monitoring, alerting, logging, and backups/restores. Support the infrastructure our engineering team builds upon: Docker container hosts, deployment targets, and databases. Operate and maintain our AWS footprint: EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, and VPC networking, all while maintaining an eye on cost, security, and reliability. Respond to incidents, dig into root causes, and put fixes in place that keep problems from recurring. Document configurations and procedures so the environment is maintainable by more than just you. Required Qualifications: 3+ years of hands-on Linux administration in a production environment. Must be comfortable at the command line, networking, storage, and package management. A doer's mindset. You'd rather fix the thing and script it than file a ticket and wait. You must be willing to take ownership and follow through without being chased. Solid scripting for automation (Bash required, Python or similar a strong plus). Working knowledge of virtualization: Proxmox specifically is ideal, but solid KVM/hypervisor experience translates. Sound networking fundamentals: firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, DNS, and routing. Must know enough to run and troubleshoot the network edge. Some AWS exposure (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC) and must be clearly capable of ramping quickly on the unknown components. Curiosity and the drive to grow into the areas of the stack you haven't mastered yet. Clear written communication and a habit of documenting what you build. Preferred/Nice-to-Have Qualifications: Hands-on Proxmox experience specifically (clustering, backups, ZFS/Ceph storage). OPNsense or pfSense firewall experience (bonus if you've run a SonicWall-to-OPNsense-style migration before). Experience configuring network switches with MLAG, preferably using MikroTik devices. Docker experience and comfortable creating highly-integrated container stacks. PostgreSQL or general database operations experience. Experience with AI tooling (e.g., Claude) for scripting, troubleshooting, or automation (we use it here, so hands-on experience is a plus). Relevant certifications (e.g., LPIC, RHCSA, or AWS SysOps/Solutions Architect).

review_candidates.title: IT Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: IT Systems Engineer LegalSight is a creative and innovative company that develops software for a broad range of legal and business functions. Our team includes veterans of the legal services industry, technology experts, and business operations professionals. We leverage our expertise to maximize opportunities for improved workflows and processes. We bring together our talent and technology to help clients achieve greater operational efficiency, reduce risks, and take advantage of innovative software solutions. We're looking for a high-energy, hands-on IT Systems Engineer who wants to own things and deploy them. This is an orchestration-first role built for someone with a strong bias for action: you'll spend as much time scripting and automating repetitive administrative work as you will configuring it, and you'll be trusted to take a messy problem and drive it to completion. You should be comfortable diagnosing a stubborn Windows endpoint, untangling a broken Purview retention or encryption policy, and writing the PowerShell or Graph automation that makes sure the problem never comes back. You'll work across identity, endpoints, collaboration tooling, and data governance. You'll be the person who understands how those Microsoft systems actually fit together, not just how each one works in isolation. This role rewards initiative. It's a broad, high-ownership mandate in which you'll own systems, not just tickets. We're looking for someone with enough experience to run with it, paired with the energy and drive to keep pushing things forward. In your first few months you'll take ownership of the M365 governance posture and stand up and properly enable Microsoft Purview (a current priority). You’ll also put automation in place that turns recurring admin tasks and helpdesk patterns into managed, hands-off workflows to make the environment measurably more secure, more consistent, and less manual. **Candidates who reside within commutable distance to our office in Ocean City, NJ and would be able to work in office two (2) day per week will be given priority. Responsibilities: Administer and harden the Microsoft 365 tenant end to end: Entra ID (Azure AD), Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and Intune. Own data governance and compliance tooling in Microsoft Purview: sensitivity labels, retention and DLP policies, eDiscovery, and information-protection / RMS encryption configuration and remediation. Streamline operations and reduce manual work: automate repetitive administrative tasks, cut down on manual monitoring, and turn one-off fixes into repeatable, hands-off processes using tools like PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Power Automate, and scheduled runbooks. We leverage AI tooling (including Claude) in our day-to-day, and you're welcome to use it here too. Manage Windows systems across the fleet: endpoint configuration, patching, imaging/provisioning, Group Policy / Intune configuration profiles, and troubleshooting at the OS level. Investigate and resolve cross-system issues: e.g., encrypted or “stuck” files spanning SharePoint and external storage, label/policy conflicts, or identity/access edge cases. Administer SharePoint Online: site architecture, permissions models, sharing governance, and content lifecycle. Build and maintain identity and access workflows: provisioning/deprovisioning, conditional access, MFA, and least-privilege role design. Support a company-wide helpdesk: handle employee IT issues and requests, resolve them efficiently, and look for the patterns worth automating so issues don’t recur. Monitor tenant and endpoint health, respond to security and compliance alerts, and drive remediation to closure. Document configurations, runbooks, and standard procedures so the environment is maintainable by the whole team. Partner with engineering, security, and operations to support integrations and keep systems aligned with business needs. Required Qualifications: 4+ years administering Windows and Microsoft 365 environments, with real ownership of the systems you've run. Ability to be a player-coach: lead by doing while mentoring less-experienced teammates. An efficiency mindset: you dislike repetitive manual work and instinctively look for ways to automate it, streamline it, or make it self-service. Comfortable using PowerShell (and, ideally, the Microsoft Graph API) to automate tasks and streamline admin work. You aren’t expected to be a full-time developer, but you should prefer writing a script to avoid repeating the same task manually. Working knowledge of Microsoft Purview: information protection, retention/DLP, and encryption/RMS concepts, including cleaning up misconfigured or legacy policies. Hands-on SharePoint Online administration (architecture, permissions, sharing governance). Solid Entra ID / Azure AD fundamentals: identity, conditional access, MFA, and access governance. Windows endpoint and server administration: Intune/MDM, Group Policy, patching, and OS-level troubleshooting. High energy, strong ownership, and a bias for action: you take a problem and drive it to completion without needing to be chased. Clear written communication and a habit of documenting what you build. Preferred/Nice-to-Have Qualifications: Experience with AI tooling (e.g., Claude) for scripting, troubleshooting, or automation (we use it here, so hands-on experience is a plus). Experience managing Mac endpoints and Apple Business Manager (ABM) in a mixed Windows/Mac environment. Experience with AWS/S3 or other cloud storage alongside M365 (helpful, not required since the core of this role is Microsoft). Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code or configuration-management tooling. A relevant Microsoft certification such as MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator) or an equivalent M365/security-compliance credential (nice to see but not required). Experience supporting a software engineering organization's developer tooling and environments.

review_candidates.description: Job Title: Senior / IT Infra Engineer (Identity and Security) Role Overview We are seeking highly skilled and innovative engineer to join our transformative SSOE Programme that manages more than 350 schools across Singapore. This is an exceptional opportunity to shape the future of educational technology infrastructure and enhance the learning experience of more than 450,000 students and 35,000 education professionals. As a Senior / IT Infra Engineer focusing on Identity and Security, you will be the primary engineer for our Zero Trust ecosystem. You will lead the end-to-end design and implementation of both a secure endpoint environment; centre heavily on Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Endpoint Protection Platforms (EPP), and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR); and identity-driven access governance utilizing on-premises Active Directory (AD) and cloud-native Entra. Your mission is to ensure that every user, device, and application within the Microsoft 365 cloud ecosystem is verified, seamlessly managed throughout the identity lifecycle, and continuously monitored against evolving threats. Key Responsibilities Identity & Access Governance Design and architect Entra ID (Azure AD) solutions, focusing on Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Identity Protection to enforce least-privileged access. Manage complex Identity Lifecycle processes, ensuring seamless and secure integration between on-premises Active Directory and cloud-native identity providers. Implement and maintain Passwordless authentication and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) strategies to eliminate credential-based vulnerabilities. Security Engineering & Threat Protection Work with security team to engineer and operate the Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Defender for Office 365 suites (EPP/EDR) to proactively hunt for threats and remediate vulnerabilities across the fleet. Deploy and manage Microsoft Purview for information protection, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and eDiscovery, ensuring sensitive corporate data remains governed and compliant. Develop automated response playbooks using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API to neutralize security incidents in real-time. Identity & Access Governance Design and architect Entra ID (Azure AD) solutions, focusing on Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Identity Protection to enforce least-privileged access. Implement and maintain Passwordless authentication and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) strategies to eliminate credential-based vulnerabilities. Lead the identity and access design for enterprise-wide rollouts, ensuring robust authentication mechanisms are baked into every deployment. Act as the primary technical liaison for Cybersecurity Audits, providing data-driven evidence of compliance regarding identity lifecycles and access control. Mentor the team on security best practices, conducting knowledge-sharing sessions on the latest Entra features and identity threat landscapes. Automation & Observability Automation: Engineer for scalability by building reusable automation and utilizing PowerShell scripting and related tools like PowerBI, Dynatrace and Axonius to monitor service health and reporting to derive insights. Scripting & API: Use PowerShell, Bash, and Python to automate repetitive tasks and interact with the Microsoft Graph API for custom reporting. Fleet Analytics: Utilize KQL and Endpoint Analytics to monitor device health, battery wear, and application performance across the entire estate. Self-Service: Develop and maintain "Self-Service" portals for both staff and students to empower users and reduce helpdesk ticket volume. General Responsibilities Engage stakeholders to translate business requirement into design and services to meet the intended availability, capacity, resiliency, security and continuity requirements. Forecast budget needed to support the project initiatives and maintenance contracts. Ensure MOE’s related Technical Architecture are in compliance with IM8 and Agency’s IT Policies and Standards. Manage day-to-day delivery and support of application infrastructure services and collaborate with other government agencies and central services teams to facilitate and deliver government-wide services. Leadership & Strategic Compliance Lead the security design for enterprise-wide software rollouts, ensuring "Security by Design" is baked into every deployment. Act as the primary technical liaison for Cybersecurity Audits, providing data-driven evidence of compliance with global security standards (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC2). Mentor the team on security best practices, conducting regular knowledge-sharing sessions on the latest M365 security features and threat landscapes. What We Are Looking For Identity Expertise: Technical mastery of both on-premises Active Directory and cloud-native Entra ID, including B2B/B2C scenarios, App Registrations, and Enterprise Applications. Security Stack Mastery: Proven experience implementing the full Microsoft 365 Defender suite and Microsoft Purview, encompassing DLP, EDR, EPP, and identity security capabilities. Automation-First Mindset: Proficiency in PowerShell and MS Graph API for comprehensive security and identity auditing, as well as automated threat remediation. Analytical Rigor: Ability to synthesize complex security and identity logs into actionable risk recommendations for executive leadership. Preferred Certifications: SC-100 (Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect), SC-300 (Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator), MS-500 (Microsoft 365 Security Administration), and CISSP or an equivalent security-focused accreditation. Proactive and dedicated individual with good leadership and multi-tasking capabilities as well as the ability to work independently without the need for close supervision. Experienced in contract and vendor management. Good communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to pitch ideas and communicate effectively with stakeholders. Team player with strong organization and people handling skills. Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

The Client Services Technical Lead will be a member of a collaborative technical support team who will provide post-sales support for complex technical product related issues. The Technical Lead will be independently providing technical support to customers, answering complex questions on function and usage of product through a variety of communication channels. You will serve as a post-sales support liaison between company and customer and if needed, would be required to support pre-sales issues encountered during Proof of Concepts. Responsibilities: Provide answers to customers’ questions, troubleshoot and resolve customer issues with complex technical products over the telephone or via electronic communications in the areas of system configurations/setup, product functionality and bugs/enhancements/upgrades. Advise customers, work to diagnose customer issues with Thales Authentication and Encryption products, and interpret logs and error messages as well as interrogate and understand the customer environment where the products are being used. Recommend solutions and workarounds to known problems and advise customers on how to apply the solution or workaround. Provide guidance and support on how to use Thales products with 3rd party solutions and supported integrations. Reproduce previously unknown issues (if need be) and interface with the Client Services Product Champion and Development team providing the customer setup and steps to reproduce the issues. Identify and document issues consistently and clearly using group tools. Support implementation of hotfixes and patches to minimize risk of unexpected issues and insure that the fix resolves the customer problem. Mentor and advise support engineers in the diagnosis of complex customer issues with Thales Authentication and Encryption products, and help them interpret logs and error messages as well as help the team to better understand and investigate customer environments as they related to the Thales products and services used therein. Own critical customer support escalations related to complex technical product issues, taking the case over from the original support engineer when necessary. Interface with the original support engineer and the customer via telephone and/or electronic communications in the areas of system configurations/setup, complex 3rd party product and code integrations, product functionality, software defect fixes, and enhancements. Be the primary owner of the knowledge base for your specific product line creating, reviewing, editing, and publishing knowledge base articles for use internally by Client Services and externally by our customers. This includes improving knowledge accessibility and the ease of use of the knowledge base. Facilitate New Product Introductions by working with the R&D and Product management teams to ensure the new design functionality is known and documented, creating materials to facilitate knowledge transfer from design to the Client Services team, and ensuring all necessary hardware and software is procured and available for use in various Client Services labs throughout the world. Requirements: 5+ year industry experience working in a customer support role, providing technical application support, troubleshooting and diagnostics in the area of network and data security products Possess a Bachelor/Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. Familiar in using encryption and cryptographic key management to protect sensitive data in database, applications, storage systems, virtualized platforms and cloud environment. You must be familiar with cryptographic concepts, public key exchange, digital signature, data communication and PKI. It would be preferred if you have familiarity with FIPS (Federal Information Processing Standards), and other NIST requirements. Knowledge of Linux operating systems such RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu and/or Windows Servers, networking such as protocols like TCP/IP and UDP; IPv4 vs IPv6. Basic Knowledge of programming languages (C/C++ and/or Java). Database skills (Oracle and MS SQL Server) is a plus. Knowledge of RSA PCKS Public-Key Cryptography Standards. Knowledge of Public cloud platforms. Familiarity with AWS, VMware vCloud Air, Microsoft Azure, etc. is an advantage Occasionally provide after hours and weekend support of products on an on-call. The on-call function is shared across the entire team and proactively scheduled to allow conflicts to be resolved ahead of time and to ensure there is no undue burden on any particular engineer. Ability to travel as required At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

review_candidates.title: Network & Automation Engineer
review_candidates.description: Make your mark at Comcast -- a Fortune 30 global media and technology company. From the connectivity and platforms we provide, to the content and experiences we create, we reach hundreds of millions of customers, viewers, and guests worldwide. Become part of our award-winning technology team that turns big ideas into cutting-edge products, platforms, and solutions that our customers love. We create space to innovate, and we recognize, reward, and invest in your ideas, while ensuring you can proudly bring your authentic self to the workplace. Join us. You’ll do the best work of your career right here at Comcast. (In most cases, Comcast prefers to have employees on-site collaborating unless the team has been designated as virtual due to the nature of their work. If a position is listed with both office locations and virtual offerings, Comcast may be willing to consider candidates who live greater than 100 miles from the office for the remote option.) Job Summary Comcast is seeking an Engineer 2, Network Engineering to support the lifecycle management of critical core network infrastructure across one of the nation's largest telecommunications networks. This role is responsible for developing and supporting automation solutions that enable the deployment, augmentation, upgrade, migration, and decommissioning of core network devices throughout their operational lifecycle. The successful candidate will combine networking expertise with software development and automation capabilities to improve configuration management, compliance validation, deployment processes, operational visibility, and network reliability. Working closely with engineering, operations, and architecture teams, this individual will help accelerate the modernization and scalability of Comcast's core network infrastructure while ensuring operational excellence across multi-vendor environments. Job Description Responsible for supporting the engineering, automation, and lifecycle management of core network infrastructure. Contributes to the deployment, augmentation, modernization, migration, and retirement of critical network devices that support Comcast's core network environment. Uses networking, software development, and automation expertise to design and improve platforms, processes, and tools that streamline device lifecycle activities, configuration management, compliance validation, operational reporting, and large-scale network deployments. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable automation solutions that enhance network reliability, operational efficiency, and service delivery. This role is based in our Mt. Laurel, NJ office. Responsibilities Support the full lifecycle management of core network devices, including deployment, augmentation, upgrades, migrations, modernization initiatives, and decommissioning activities. Develop and maintain Python-based automation solutions that streamline network device onboarding, configuration management, validation, and retirement processes. Assist in planning and executing network infrastructure changes to support capacity growth, technology refreshes, and network transformation initiatives. Build and enhance platforms that support large-scale configuration deployment, device lifecycle management, compliance tracking, and operational reporting. Validate network configurations and perform audits to ensure compliance with engineering standards and operational requirements. Analyze network telemetry, operational data, configuration information, and system logs to identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities. Support execution of network device provisioning, software upgrades, hardware refreshes, migrations, and end-of-life decommissioning efforts. Collaborate with engineering, operations, architecture, and software development teams to integrate automation and telemetry into operational workflows. Assist in troubleshooting routing, connectivity, and network performance issues across large-scale multi-vendor environments. Participate in the development of automation frameworks used for network validation, anomaly detection, testing, and deployment assurance. Contribute to release management, CI/CD initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts supporting network automation platforms. Monitor network performance and assist in identifying infrastructure enhancements that improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. Document network systems, lifecycle management procedures, automation workflows, deployment standards, and operational processes. Participate in developing network engineering strategies and provide technical recommendations supporting future infrastructure growth and modernization. Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance. Regular, consistent, and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedules, and maintenance windows as required. Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. Qualifications This position is ineligible for visa sponsorship. To be considered for this role, you must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require sponsorship for employment now or in the future. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. 2+ years of experience supporting network engineering, network operations, automation engineering, systems engineering, or related technical functions. Knowledge of TCP/IP networking, subnetting, routing, switching, packet analysis, and OSI model fundamentals. Experience supporting the deployment, operation, upgrade, migration, or decommissioning of network infrastructure devices in enterprise, service provider, telecommunications, or large-scale production environments. Understanding of routing protocols including OSPF, ISIS, EIGRP, and BGP concepts. Experience with Python or another scripting language used for automation and operational tooling. Ability to develop scripts and tools that automate operational network tasks and workflows. Experience working with network device configurations, operational datasets, telemetry, or log analysis. Familiarity with Git or other version control technologies. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively across multiple engineering and operational teams. Preference For Candidates Who Also Have The Following Exposure to AI/ML assisted tools or automation Familiarity with network simulation or lab environments Employees At All Levels Are Expected To Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job. Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services. Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences. Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas. Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers. Drive results and growth. Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead. Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities. Disclaimer: This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications. Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Skills Network Performance; Collaboration; Network Engineering; Scripting Salary New Jersey Pay Range: $78,505.90 - $117,758.85 Comcast intends to offer the selected candidate base pay within this range, dependent on job-related, non-discriminatory factors such as experience. The application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later. Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details. Education Bachelor's Degree While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience. Relevant Work Experience 2-5 Years

review_candidates.title: Technical Support Engineer II
review_candidates.description: Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate! Passion, excitement & global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world. What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you! Who we are: Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments in higher education. We’ve since scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world. Today we support more than 5,300 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies. With over 1,400+ global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow. Job Description The Opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Technical Support Engineer II to work directly with customers and cross-functional teams on daily support and operational tasks. In this role, you will support Flywire’s Student Financial Services (SFS), eStore, and TPI products for our clients across the U.S. and Canada. A unique and critical aspect of this role is proactively leveraging AI tools (such as Claude and Gemini) as a smart personal assistant to automate day-to-day TSE workflows, maintain internal repositories, assist with issue investigations, and streamline client communications. Key Responsibilities: Technical Support & Troubleshooting Ticket Management: Manage and resolve customer and departmental tickets efficiently, ensuring the highest quality standards while strictly adhering to SLA requirements. Deep Research: Work hands-on with web-based products and command-line tools to thoroughly research and isolate complex support issues. Issue Resolution: Logically assess technical problems, propose accurate solutions to customers, and collaborate with development teams on long-term product enhancements. Communication & Collaboration Client Communication: Communicate clearly, concisely, and confidently with customers via email or phone, translating highly complex technical issues into easy-to-understand explanations based on the client’s technical level. Cross-Functional Liaison: Serve as a highly effective mediator and escalation bridge between customers and the product/engineering teams. Business Alignment: Align technical support goals with Flywire’s broader business domain, vision, mission, and strategy to deliver on both short- and long-term goals. AI & Knowledge Management AI Repository Maintenance: Manage and maintain the TSE team's AI Skills repository, TSE Project Repos, and internal knowledge base. AI Automation: Utilize AI tools to automate routine maintenance tasks, investigate client issues, create bug/product enhancement requests for dev teams, and draft effective, professional client communications. Qualifications Here’s What We’re Looking For: 3-5 years of experience in technical support engineering. 3+ years of hands-on experience with MySQL, Regular Expressions (Regex), and SaaS-based web applications. Proficiency in leveraging AI tools - specifically Claude - to optimize day-to-day tasks and boost operational efficiency. B.S. degree in a science or engineering field. Outstanding verbal and written communication skills. Detail-oriented, highly organized multitasker with a strong eagerness to learn new technologies and a drive to go above and beyond to find root causes. Preferred Qualifications: A master's degree in a respective science or engineering field is a plus. Experience in higher education, Student Financial Services (SFS), FinTech, or the payments industry. Familiarity with industry-standard logging, analytics, and ticketing tooling. Technologies & Tools We Use: Core Technologies: MySQL, Java, SaaS Web Applications, HTTP/SFTP Protocols AI Assistants: Claude Code, Google Gemini, Notebook LM Operations & Tooling: Zendesk, Jira, Confluence, SumoLogic, Looker Additional Information Submit today and get started! We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager and other Flymates. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for questions. Flywire is an equal opportunity employer and follows a policy of administering all employment decisions and personnel actions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity, national origin, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, genetic disposition or carrier status, veteran status, or any other category protected under applicable national, federal, state or local law. The US base salary range for this full-time position is $81,000 - $101,000 and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, position level, and location. The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and several other factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education and training.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Stratus Engineering partners with government and mission-focused organizations to turn fragmented data, systems, and operational challenges into clear decisions and measurable results. We specialize in integrated solutions that improve performance, enhance transparency, and support complex missions. Our teams work directly with public sector stakeholders to streamline processes and modernize technology environments, giving technical professionals the chance to contribute to projects with real organizational and societal impact. Position Summary The SharePoint Coordinator is a full-time, on-site role based in Washington, DC. This position is responsible for configuring, maintaining, and optimizing SharePoint sites and libraries to support collaboration and information management across the organization. The SharePoint Coordinator owns site structure, permissions, and document workflows, provides end-user support and training, and partners with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, implement solutions, and safeguard data integrity and continuity. Key Responsibilities Configure and administer SharePoint Online site collections: site creation, navigation, page layouts, web parts, and lists. Build and maintain document libraries, content types, metadata schemas, and retention settings. Manage permissions and access groups, including periodic access reviews and prompt removals at offboarding. review_candidates.description: You will provide hands-on technical support to automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, and autonomous-driving technology companies using TomTom ADAS maps, services, and SDKs. You will help customers integrate products efficiently, reproduce and resolve issues, validate releases, and build the knowledge and tools required for reliable production support. What You'll Do Provide responsive L2/L3 technical support for ADAS map data, SDKs, APIs, developer tools, and customer integration environments through remote and on-site engagement. Support customer onboarding, environment setup, SDK configuration, credentials, map access, sample applications, and first successful data retrieval or horizon generation. Reproduce, triage, and resolve issues involving SDK behavior, map content, positioning, map matching, route projection, ADASIS output, service connectivity, performance, and platform compatibility. Collect high-quality diagnostic evidence, including logs, traces, configuration, software versions, map tiles, vehicle routes, timestamps, and reproducible test steps. Differentiate product defects, map-data issues, integration errors, environmental constraints, and unsupported use cases, then route each issue to the correct engineering owner. Work with global map, SDK, platform, and operations teams to track escalations, communicate impact, validate fixes, and keep customers informed with clear technical updates. Execute release qualification and regression testing on representative Android, Linux, or QNX environments and document results against agreed acceptance criteria. Inspect and visualize road- and lane-level map attributes, compare SDK output with expected data, and support field or simulation-based validation activities. Create and maintain bilingual troubleshooting guides, known-issue records, FAQs, test procedures, support runbooks, and integration examples. Identify recurring support themes and recommend improvements to product usability, diagnostics, documentation, tooling, and customer onboarding. Based in Shanghai or Beijing. What You'll Need Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Software Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Geomatics, Electronics, or a related discipline. Typically 3 + years of technical support, software integration, validation, or application-engineering experience in automotive, mapping, navigation, ADAS, or autonomous driving. Working knowledge of ADAS map content, including road topology, lane geometry and connectivity, speed restrictions, curvature, gradient, traffic signs, and dynamic road conditions. \ Experience supporting SDKs, APIs, embedded software, or map-data pipelines, with the ability to read technical documentation and understand interface contracts. Proficiency with Linux command-line tools, logs, shell scripting, networking fundamentals, and structured troubleshooting; exposure to QNX or Android Automotive is strongly valued. Programming or scripting capability in C++, Java/Kotlin, and/or Python sufficient to understand sample code, build small test tools, and automate diagnostics. Familiarity with REST, MQTT, Kafka, Protobuf , JSON, or comparable service and data-delivery technologies. Experience with issue-management and engineering collaboration tools, plus disciplined incident documentation and follow-through. Strong analytical skills, customer empathy, ownership, and the ability to remain effective during critical integration or launch situations. Fluent Chinese and professional English; willing to travel to customer sites for workshops, vehicle tests, and production-critical support. What's Nice To Have Experience at a digital map, navigation, ADAS, autonomous-driving algorithm, intelligent-vehicle, or automotive software company. Knowledge of NDS, NDS.Live , ADASIS v2/v3, OGP, PBF, OpenLR , GIS, map visualization, or equivalent proprietary technologies. Experience supporting OEM or Tier-1 programs on automotive SoCs and embedded platforms. Hands-on exposure to vehicle logs, GNSS/positioning data, CAN or Ethernet traces, simulation, test drives, or map-quality validation. Understanding of software release processes, CI/CD, automated testing, defect triage, and root-cause analysis. What We Offer A competitive compensation package, of course. Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities. Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location. Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping. Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. Meet your team We’re TomTom Automotive. On our team, your work – together with our 30+ years of experience in delivering connected navigation software, traffic information and highly accurate digital maps – will accelerate the future of driving. Car manufacturers trust us to provide the modular components they need to create competitive, tailor-made infotainment systems, and the mapping technology that are enabling self-driving cars to see beyond their sensors. At TomTom... You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet. Work with a team of 3,300+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them. We deliver technology-focused solutions with a broad range of products, which are designed, engineered, and built, at one of our nine worldwide facilities. Position Summary The Product Support Engineer serves as the primary technical liaison between customers, sales and service organizations, manufacturing, quality, and engineering teams. This role is responsible for supporting TLD Ground Support Equipment (GSE) products throughout their lifecycle by resolving complex technical issues, leading root cause investigations, supporting product improvements, and ensuring customer satisfaction. The Product Support Engineer combines hands-on troubleshooting with engineering analysis to improve product reliability, support global service organizations, and provide feedback that drives continuous product innovation. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Technical Support & Customer Assistance: Provide advanced technical support for electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, HVAC, diesel engine, PLC, and structural systems used in TLD Ground Support Equipment. Support field technicians, customers, and global service organizations in the diagnosis and resolution of product-related issues. Respond to technical inquiries from sales, service, manufacturing, and customer organizations promptly. Product Improvement & Engineering Support Conduct root cause investigations of product failures and field-reported issues using structured problem-solving methodologies. Act as the voice of the customer by providing field feedback to engineering teams during product development and product improvement initiatives. Documentation & Training Develop and maintain technical service bulletins, troubleshooting guides, repair procedures, and technical communications. Assist in the development and maintenance of product manuals, service documentation, and technical datasheets. Develop field test procedures and validation plans to verify corrective actions and product improvements. Support technical training programs for service technicians, distributors, customers, and internal personnel. Compliance & Continuous Improvement Support quality initiatives and corrective action processes in accordance with ISO 9001 requirements. Participate in continuous improvement activities focused on product quality, reliability, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency. Maintain technical proficiency through ongoing training, seminars, trade shows, and industry events. Perform other duties as assigned by management. Qualifications And Experience To perform this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Experience troubleshooting complex electrical, hydraulic, mechanical, HVAC, diesel engine, and control systems. Experience conducting root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions. Experience interacting directly with customers, service organizations, and cross-functional engineering teams. Practical hands-on troubleshooting experience is highly preferred. Other Skills And Abilities Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite. Experience with ERP/MRP systems. Familiarity with CAD drawings and engineering documentation. Experience with PLC-based control systems and troubleshooting is preferred. Experience with diagnostic tools, data acquisition systems, and technical reporting. Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality systems. Adobe Acrobat and technical publishing software experience preferred. Education Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related technical discipline. Equivalent combination of education and relevant technical experience may be considered. Preferred Characteristics The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving challenging technical problems, working directly with customers, and driving product improvements from concept through implementation. This individual thrives in a fast-paced environment and serves as a critical link between the field and engineering organizations. The Company is committed to protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of its information assets in alignment with ISO 27001. All employees are required to follow information security policies, safeguard company data and systems, and promptly report any suspected security incidents or violations.

Apply now or contact Cloud Decisions for a confidential conversation.

We're looking for a high-energy, hands-on IT Systems Engineer who wants to own things and deploy them. This is an orchestration-first role built for someone with a strong bias for action: you'll spend as much time scripting and automating repetitive administrative work as you will configuring it, and you'll be trusted to take a messy problem and drive it to completion. You should be comfortable diagnosing a stubborn Windows endpoint, untangling a broken Purview retention or encryption policy, and writing the PowerShell or Graph automation that makes sure the problem never comes back. You'll work across identity, endpoints, collaboration tooling, and data governance. You'll be the person who understands how those Microsoft systems actually fit together, not just how each one works in isolation. This role rewards initiative. It's a broad, high-ownership mandate in which you'll own systems, not just tickets. We're looking for someone with enough experience to run with it, paired with the energy and drive to keep pushing things forward. In your first few months you'll take ownership of the M365 governance posture and stand up and properly enable Microsoft Purview (a current priority). You’ll also put automation in place that turns recurring admin tasks and helpdesk patterns into managed, hands-off workflows to make the environment measurably more secure, more consistent, and less manual. **Candidates who reside within commutable distance to our office in Ocean City, NJ and would be able to work in office two (2) day per week will be given priority. Responsibilities: Administer and harden the Microsoft 365 tenant end to end: Entra ID (Azure AD), Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and Intune. Own data governance and compliance tooling in Microsoft Purview: sensitivity labels, retention and DLP policies, eDiscovery, and information-protection / RMS encryption configuration and remediation. Streamline operations and reduce manual work: automate repetitive administrative tasks, cut down on manual monitoring, and turn one-off fixes into repeatable, hands-off processes using tools like PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Power Automate, and scheduled runbooks. We leverage AI tooling (including Claude) in our day-to-day, and you're welcome to use it here too. Manage Windows systems across the fleet: endpoint configuration, patching, imaging/provisioning, Group Policy / Intune configuration profiles, and troubleshooting at the OS level. Investigate and resolve cross-system issues: e.g., encrypted or “stuck” files spanning SharePoint and external storage, label/policy conflicts, or identity/access edge cases. Administer SharePoint Online: site architecture, permissions models, sharing governance, and content lifecycle. Build and maintain identity and access workflows: provisioning/deprovisioning, conditional access, MFA, and least-privilege role design. Support a company-wide helpdesk: handle employee IT issues and requests, resolve them efficiently, and look for the patterns worth automating so issues don’t recur. Monitor tenant and endpoint health, respond to security and compliance alerts, and drive remediation to closure. Document configurations, runbooks, and standard procedures so the environment is maintainable by the whole team. Partner with engineering, security, and operations to support integrations and keep systems aligned with business needs. Required Qualifications: 4+ years administering Windows and Microsoft 365 environments, with real ownership of the systems you've run. Ability to be a player-coach: lead by doing while mentoring less-experienced teammates. An efficiency mindset: you dislike repetitive manual work and instinctively look for ways to automate it, streamline it, or make it self-service. Comfortable using PowerShell (and, ideally, the Microsoft Graph API) to automate tasks and streamline admin work. You aren’t expected to be a full-time developer, but you should prefer writing a script to avoid repeating the same task manually. Working knowledge of Microsoft Purview: information protection, retention/DLP, and encryption/RMS concepts, including cleaning up misconfigured or legacy policies. Hands-on SharePoint Online administration (architecture, permissions, sharing governance). Solid Entra ID / Azure AD fundamentals: identity, conditional access, MFA, and access governance. Windows endpoint and server administration: Intune/MDM, Group Policy, patching, and OS-level troubleshooting. High energy, strong ownership, and a bias for action: you take a problem and drive it to completion without needing to be chased. Clear written communication and a habit of documenting what you build. Preferred/Nice-to-Have Qualifications: Experience with AI tooling (e.g., Claude) for scripting, troubleshooting, or automation (we use it here, so hands-on experience is a plus). Experience managing Mac endpoints and Apple Business Manager (ABM) in a mixed Windows/Mac environment. Experience with AWS/S3 or other cloud storage alongside M365 (helpful, not required since the core of this role is Microsoft). Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code or configuration-management tooling. A relevant Microsoft certification such as MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator) or an equivalent M365/security-compliance credential (nice to see but not required). Experience supporting a software engineering organization's developer tooling and environments.

Collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable automation solutions that enhance network reliability, operational efficiency, and service delivery. This role is based in our Mt. Laurel, NJ office. Develop and maintain Python-based automation solutions that streamline network device onboarding, configuration management, validation, and retirement processes. Assist in planning and executing network infrastructure changes to support capacity growth, technology refreshes, and network transformation initiatives. Build and enhance platforms that support large-scale configuration deployment, device lifecycle management, compliance tracking, and operational reporting. Validate network configurations and perform audits to ensure compliance with engineering standards and operational requirements. Analyze network telemetry, operational data, configuration information, and system logs to identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities. Support execution of network device provisioning, software upgrades, hardware refreshes, migrations, and end-of-life decommissioning efforts. Collaborate with engineering, operations, architecture, and software development teams to integrate automation and telemetry into operational workflows. Assist in troubleshooting routing, connectivity, and network performance issues across large-scale multi-vendor environments. Participate in the development of automation frameworks used for network validation, anomaly detection, testing, and deployment assurance. Contribute to release management, CI/CD initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts supporting network automation platforms. Monitor network performance and assist in identifying infrastructure enhancements that improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. Document network systems, lifecycle management procedures, automation workflows, deployment standards, and operational processes. Participate in developing network engineering strategies and provide technical recommendations supporting future infrastructure growth and modernization. Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance. Regular, consistent, and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedules, and maintenance windows as required. Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. Qualifications This position is ineligible for visa sponsorship. To be considered for this role, you must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require sponsorship for employment now or in the future. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. 2+ years of experience supporting network engineering, network operations, automation engineering, systems engineering, or related technical functions. Knowledge of TCP/IP networking, subnetting, routing, switching, packet analysis, and OSI model fundamentals. Experience supporting the deployment, operation, upgrade, migration, or decommissioning of network infrastructure devices in enterprise, service provider, telecommunications, or large-scale production environments. Understanding of routing protocols including OSPF, ISIS, EIGRP, and BGP concepts. Experience with Python or another scripting language used for automation and operational tooling. Ability to develop scripts and tools that automate operational network tasks and workflows. Experience working with network device configurations, operational datasets, telemetry, or log analysis. Familiarity with Git or other version control technologies. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively across multiple engineering and operational teams. Proficiency in leveraging AI tools - specifically Claude - to optimize day-to-day tasks and boost operational efficiency. B.S. degree in a science or engineering field. Outstanding verbal and written communication skills. Detail-oriented, highly organized multitasker with a strong eagerness to learn new technologies and a drive to go above and beyond to find root causes. Preferred Qualifications: A master's degree in a respective science or engineering field is a plus. Experience in higher education, Student Financial Services (SFS), FinTech, or the payments industry. Familiarity with industry-standard logging, analytics, and ticketing tooling. Acting as a centralized hub, the team monitors system performance, detects issues, and leads incident response calls to drive rapid resolution and minimize disruptions. In close partnership with Software, Hardware, and System Performance Engineering teams, the NOC translates customer feedback and technical data into continuous improvements that enhance Symbotic’s next-generation microsystems. Document incidents, resolutions, root cause findings, and corrective actions to support continuous improvement. Identify recurring issues and partner with engineering teams to reduce repeat incidents and improve system stability. Support system, software, and network updates, including validation activities to help ensure successful deployment with minimal operational impact. Analyze system and incident data to identify trends, support troubleshooting, and improve visibility into system performance. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, runbooks, technical documentation, and training materials. Create scripts, tools, or process improvements that help streamline triage, incident response, reporting, and support workflows. Incorporate customer and site feedback to help identify product, process, and operational improvement opportunities. Share knowledge with team members and support onboarding through documentation, training, and peer collaboration. Participate in a 10x7 operational support model, including an on-call rotation for escalations and critical issues. Work on-site in MA to support system troubleshooting, cross-functional collaboration, and operational readiness. What You’ll Need Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. Minimum 2+ years of experience in technical support, NOC operations, systems engineering, site reliability, or a similar operational support environment. Strong technical troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience supporting production systems, including incident response, escalation management, root cause analysis, and operational documentation. Familiarity with automation, controls, or material handling systems, including PLCs, VFDs, motion control, or servo tuning; Allen-Bradley ControlLogix experience preferred. Hands-on experience with electrical and mechanical troubleshooting, ideally in a robotics or automation setting. Proficiency with Linux/Unix environments and scripting languages such as Python. Experience using or developing dashboards, reporting tools, or system monitoring platforms; familiarity with Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools preferred. Exposure to databases, data warehouses, or knowledge-based systems preferred. Ability to communicate technical issues clearly across Software, Hardware, Systems, Operations, and Engineering teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document issues, resolutions, runbooks, and technical processes. Willingness to participate in a 10x7 operational support model (Wednesday through Saturday), including an on-call rotation for escalations and critical issues. Ability to work a hybrid schedule, with two days per week on-site at our Wilmington headquarters and two days remote. Our Environment Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi-weekly basis. About Symbotic Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. new_matches.title: Support Engineer - ADAS
new_matches.description: You will provide hands-on technical support to automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, and autonomous-driving technology companies using TomTom ADAS maps, services, and SDKs. You will help customers integrate products efficiently, reproduce and resolve issues, validate releases, and build the knowledge and tools required for reliable production support. What You'll Do Provide responsive L2/L3 technical support for ADAS map data, SDKs, APIs, developer tools, and customer integration environments through remote and on-site engagement. Support customer onboarding, environment setup, SDK configuration, credentials, map access, sample applications, and first successful data retrieval or horizon generation. Reproduce, triage, and resolve issues involving SDK behavior, map content, positioning, map matching, route projection, ADASIS output, service connectivity, performance, and platform compatibility. Collect high-quality diagnostic evidence, including logs, traces, configuration, software versions, map tiles, vehicle routes, timestamps, and reproducible test steps. Differentiate product defects, map-data issues, integration errors, environmental constraints, and unsupported use cases, then route each issue to the correct engineering owner. Work with global map, SDK, platform, and operations teams to track escalations, communicate impact, validate fixes, and keep customers informed with clear technical updates. Execute release qualification and regression testing on representative Android, Linux, or QNX environments and document results against agreed acceptance criteria. Inspect and visualize road- and lane-level map attributes, compare SDK output with expected data, and support field or simulation-based validation activities. Create and maintain bilingual troubleshooting guides, known-issue records, FAQs, test procedures, support runbooks, and integration examples. Identify recurring support themes and recommend improvements to product usability, diagnostics, documentation, tooling, and customer onboarding. Based in Shanghai or Beijing. What You'll Need Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Software Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Geomatics, Electronics, or a related discipline. Typically 3 + years of technical support, software integration, validation, or application-engineering experience in automotive, mapping, navigation, ADAS, or autonomous driving. Working knowledge of ADAS map content, including road topology, lane geometry and connectivity, speed restrictions, curvature, gradient, traffic signs, and dynamic road conditions. \ Experience supporting SDKs, APIs, embedded software, or map-data pipelines, with the ability to read technical documentation and understand interface contracts. Proficiency with Linux command-line tools, logs, shell scripting, networking fundamentals, and structured troubleshooting; exposure to QNX or Android Automotive is strongly valued. Programming or scripting capability in C++, Java/Kotlin, and/or Python sufficient to understand sample code, build small test tools, and automate diagnostics. Familiarity with REST, MQTT, Kafka, Protobuf , JSON, or comparable service and data-delivery technologies. Experience with issue-management and engineering collaboration tools, plus disciplined incident documentation and follow-through. Strong analytical skills, customer empathy, ownership, and the ability to remain effective during critical integration or launch situations. Fluent Chinese and professional English; willing to travel to customer sites for workshops, vehicle tests, and production-critical support. What's Nice To Have Experience at a digital map, navigation, ADAS, autonomous-driving algorithm, intelligent-vehicle, or automotive software company. Knowledge of NDS, NDS.Live , ADASIS v2/v3, OGP, PBF, OpenLR , GIS, map visualization, or equivalent proprietary technologies. Experience supporting OEM or Tier-1 programs on automotive SoCs and embedded platforms. Hands-on exposure to vehicle logs, GNSS/positioning data, CAN or Ethernet traces, simulation, test drives, or map-quality validation. Understanding of software release processes, CI/CD, automated testing, defect triage, and root-cause analysis. What We Offer A competitive compensation package, of course. Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities. Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location. Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping. Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. Meet your team We’re TomTom Automotive. On our team, your work – together with our 30+ years of experience in delivering connected navigation software, traffic information and highly accurate digital maps – will accelerate the future of driving. Car manufacturers trust us to provide the modular components they need to create competitive, tailor-made infotainment systems, and the mapping technology that are enabling self-driving cars to see beyond their sensors.
